description: Standing Operating Protocols (SOPs) for the Reactive Protocol Engine. Each protocol maps a LOW_FIDELITY stoplight trigger condition from a specific instrument class to physics/behavior modifiers and resource costs.

protocols.name: Enhanced Ventilation
protocols.description: Upgrade HVAC filtration when airborne anomaly is detected.

protocols.name: HEPA Lockdown Ventilation
protocols.description: Deploy maximum HEPA filtration on RED airborne alert.

protocols.name: Surface Disinfection Protocol
protocols.description: Deploy sanitizer teams when surface swab triggers AMBER or above.

protocols.name: PPE Deployment — Standard
protocols.description: Issue surgical masks and gloves when wastewater flags AMBER.

protocols.name: PPE Deployment — Full N95
protocols.description: Issue N95 respirators and face shields on RED wastewater or RED air alert.

protocols.name: Increased Diagnostic Cadence
protocols.description: Double diagnostic testing frequency when clinical RDT flags AMBER.

protocols.name: Galley Closure & Meal Isolation
protocols.description: Close communal dining on RED clinical microbiology (GI flora disruption).

protocols.name: Individual Symptomatic Confinement to Quarters
protocols.description: Quarantine symptomatic agents to their berthing compartments upon RED clinical RDT. Agents remain HVAC-connected in their home zone. FRED quarantine compliance governs whether agents comply immediately or delay.

protocols.name: General Confinement to Quarters
protocols.description: Full ship-wide quarantine to quarters (lockdown). Requires LOCKDOWN escalation (cumulative attack rate threshold), not stoplight alone. All non-essential personnel confined to home zones; only watchstanders and medical crew exempt. Quarantined agents remain HVAC-connected. Severe reduction in direct contact, droplet, and fomite transmission.

protocols.name: VSP-Threshold Mass Isolation
protocols.description: Quarantine symptomatic agents upon RED clinical RDT with outbreak-response surface disinfection. The VSP 3% attack-rate threshold is now enforced via configurable infection_counters in config.yaml rather than an engine-internal check. Agents remain HVAC-connected in their home zone.

protocols.name: Selective Passenger Confinement (Diamond Princess)
protocols.description: Confine symptomatic passengers to quarters while crew remain operational. Reflects the Diamond Princess precedent where crew continued service duties during outbreak containment. All crew classes are exempt from confinement orders. Passengers are quarantined to their home zones (HVAC-connected) upon RED clinical RDT.

protocols.name: Wearable Individual Health Triage
protocols.description: Route agents with RED wearable physiological alerts to symptomatic confinement. Individual-scope response triggered by per-agent fever or multi-channel anomaly.

protocols.name: Wearable Fleet Surveillance Escalation
protocols.description: Shipwide increase in diagnostic cadence when fleet-level wearable fever or anomaly rates reach AMBER.

protocols.name: Wearable Fleet Outbreak Response
protocols.description: Shipwide PPE deployment when fleet wearable monitor reaches RED (elevated fever or anomaly rates across the monitored population).

protocols.name: Integrated Detection Escalation — Elevated
protocols.description: Escalation SOP integrating syndromic, wearable, environmental, and clinical detection modes. Activates when at least two modes simultaneously reach AMBER or worse.

protocols.name: Integrated Detection Escalation — Critical
protocols.description: Critical escalation when at least two integrated detection modes reach RED simultaneously. Combines symptomatic confinement with standard PPE and outbreak-response surface disinfection.

protocols.name: Replayed Cabin Quarantine of All Passengers
protocols.description: Confine every passenger to quarters while all crew classes remain operational. This is the passenger/crew asymmetry both replayed COVID hulls actually ran: Diamond Princess quarantined passengers in their cabins from 5 February 2020 while crew continued essential service, and Greg Mortimer confined all passengers from voyage day 8 while crew kept working. SOP-011 covers the reactive version of the same idea for symptomatic passengers only; this one is the whole-passenger-body order that an authority issued on a known date, so its trigger is unreachable by design (no instrument reports 'scenario_calendar') and it activates only when a scenario schedule names it — see engines/scenario_schedule.py. It declares no compliance, PPE or efficacy figure: what confinement does to transmission is whatever the existing movement and contact machinery does with a confined agent.

protocols.name: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL: Cabin Quarantine of All Hands (historically false)
protocols.description: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL, historically FALSE: Diamond Princess crew kept working essential service throughout the quarantine, and that passenger/crew asymmetry is exactly what SOP-017 encodes. This protocol exists only as arm A1/A4 of covid_quarantine_attribution_v1, to be differenced against SOP-017 so the crew channel's contribution during confinement can be measured. It may never be used to score covid.T1, covid.T3, covid.H3 or any other anchor. Like SOP-017 its trigger is unreachable (no instrument reports 'scenario_calendar') and it activates only when a scenario schedule names it — see engines/scenario_schedule.py.

protocols.name: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL: Cabin Quarantine, Engineering+Medical Crew Only Exempt
protocols.description: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL for CREW-WINDOW-01 (docs/covid/covid_crew_window_01_design.md): SOP-017 with exempt_classes narrowed to engineering and medical only — the unambiguous reading of 'essential service' — differenced against the shipped all-four-crew exemption to read which working-crew classes carry the during-quarantine tail. An attribution probe, not a candidate configuration: it may never score covid.T1/T3/H3 or any other anchor. Trigger unreachable by design; activates only when a scenario schedule names it.

Lottery expectation 11/34 ~ 0.324 of crew exempt under the uniform posting draw. An attribution probe, not a candidate configuration: it may never score covid.T1/T3/H3 or any other anchor. protocols.description: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL for CREW-MESS-01 (docs/covid/covid_crew_mess_01_design.md): verbatim SOP-017-NARROW plus crew_meal_service mode boxed — the documented Diamond Princess response of distributing crew meals rather than seating a communal mess. While the order is active every crew placement resolving into a crew-mess zone resolves to home_zone (mess-posted staff keep their posting: the kitchen still produces the boxes). An intervention arm, not a candidate configuration: it may never score covid.T1/T3/H3 or any other anchor. Trigger unreachable by design; activates only when a scenario schedule names it.

An intervention arm, not a candidate configuration: it may never score covid.T1/T3/H3 or any other anchor. Trigger unreachable by design; activates only when a scenario schedule names it.

protocols.description: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL for CREW-MESS-01 (docs/covid/covid_crew_mess_01_design.md): verbatim SOP-017-NARROW plus crew_meal_service mode capacity occupancy_fraction 0.10 — mess occupancy capped at one tenth of rated seats (~105 across both messes vs ~260-330 exempt crew); diners past the cap take boxed meals in cabin. An intervention arm, not a candidate configuration: it may never score covid.T1/T3/H3 or any other anchor. Trigger unreachable by design; activates only when a scenario schedule names it.
